```{r}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
# Shared by the study results pages (included, not rendered on its own: the
# leading underscore keeps Quarto from making it a page). Shows a study's
# regional table, saved to tables/ by its study script. Reads that file only;
# runs no analysis.
show_region_table <- function(study) {
  path <- file.path("..", "tables", paste0(study, "_regions.csv"))
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    return(knitr::asis_output("*The table appears once `R/main.R` has been run.*"))
  }
  knitr::kable(read.csv(path, check.names = FALSE), align = "lrrrr")
}
```
